content: Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of linagliptin by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Alternative treatments are strongly recommended when linagliptin is co-administered with a P-gp inducer. Rifampin decreases lofepramine levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Lomitapide increases rifampin levels via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended, with consideration for dose reduction when used concurrently. Rifampin reduces loperamide levels or effects through the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases losartan levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzymes CYP2C9/10 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rifampin reduces lovastatin levels or effects via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Lumacaftor and ivacaftor interact with rifampin by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2B6 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. In vitro studies suggest lumacaftor may induce and ivacaftor may inhibit CYP2B6 substrates. Rifampin decreases maraviroc levels or effects via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rifampin reduces marijuana levels or effects by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Mavorixafor increases rifampin levels via the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Co-administration with sensitive P-gp substrates may lead to serious adverse effects. Rifampin decreases medroxyprogesterone levels or effects by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary, as contraceptive failure is possible. Rifampin decreases melatonin levels or effects by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP1A2 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases miconazole vaginal levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rifampin reduces mifepristone levels or effects by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inducers is not recommended. Rifampin decreases mipomersen levels, potentially increasing toxicity due to elevated hepatic enzymes. Liver function tests should be monitored closely. Rifampin reduces mirtazapine levels or effects by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Rifampin increases momelotinib toxicity due to its effect on OATP1B1/1B3 substrates, which may elevate plasma concentrations and adverse reaction risks. Caution and monitoring are advised. Rifampin decreases montelukast levels or effects by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Nafcillin reduces rifampin effects through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are advised, as nafcillin may antagonize effects against S. aureus.
